title: Vite middleware 404 body discloses absolute home-directory path
description: When the manifest file is missing, the dev-server middleware returns a 404 body containing MANIFEST_DISK_PATH verbatim, which is the absolute path under the developer's home directory (e.g. /Users/<username>/workspace/deepbook-sandbox/sandbox/deployments/localnet.json). This leaks the OS username and the developer's filesystem layout to anyone able to GET /localnet.json from the dev server.
impact: On a localhost-only dev server this is harmless — the same user already has shell access. If a developer ever exposes the dev server beyond loopback (e.g. via vite --host or a tunneling tool), the 404 body gives a small piece of host fingerprinting. Slot 1 is dev-only and read-only, so the practical impact is negligible.
recommendation: Optional: replace the path in the 404 body with a relative pointer (e.g. 'sandbox/deployments/localnet.json') and keep the actionable bootstrap command. No code change is required for this cycle's contract.
evidence: error: `localnet.json not found at ${MANIFEST_DISK_PATH}. Run pnpm deploy-all from the deepbook-sandbox repo.`
